tests/unit/document-network-capture.test.ts around lines 175-224 injects old sequence 999 and new sequence 1 before frame commit and asserts only the new document response; tests/unit/document-network-saved-ui.test.tsx around lines 208-352 sends stale/current rows through the real saved UI path and asserts only CURRENT_DOCUMENT_ROW renders. original_closure_requirements.limit: No cited installed Chrome run deliberately held and released an old-document response after new navigation began, or observed same-URL replacement rejection. Native HN success alone cannot prove this adversarial isolation.
